plan.notes: Source: official Barton CC degree map 'Elementary Education (Systemwide Transfer), Emphasis of Study, Associate in Science - 60 Credit Hours' (Review Date: 09/25, Effective Date: 08/25; no catalog-year label, stamped retrieval year 2026-2027). Sequenced TERM 1-4 as printed. The Natural & Physical Science Requirement*** is printed as '3-5' sh with a printed Term 4 total of 15, so it is sequenced at its 3-sh minimum and the plan totals 60. Footnotes: ^ HIST 1400 or 1402 fulfill the American History Requirement; ** POLS 1800, SOCI 1129, or EDUC 1103 (cannot be counted in two buckets) fulfill the Elementary Ed Designated slots; ^^ the Life Science Requirement must be a LIFE science course with lab (LIFE 1402, 1407, 1408, 1412, or 1413 and 1414); *** any physical science/physics course, lab not required; **** any ARTS, MUSI, THEA, or LITR course fulfills the Fine Arts Requirement. The map states the degree is built to transfer as part of KBOR's Universal Transfer Pathway (all 60 credits apply toward a bachelor's degree). To meet the Social & Behavioral Sciences criteria there must be at least two courses from two different subject areas (ANTH, ECON, GEOG, POLS, PSYC, SOCI).
